families.name: Graphene / carbon layers
families.description: Single- and few-layer carbon systems; ARPES focuses on Dirac cones, doping, twist angle, minibands, and many-body velocity renormalization.

families.name: 2D insulators / h-BN
families.description: Wide-gap layered insulators used as substrates, tunnel barriers, and reference van der Waals crystals.

families.name: TMD semiconductors
families.description: Mo- and W-based dichalcogenides; ARPES tracks direct/indirect gaps, spin-orbit splitting, valleys, and layer-dependent band shifts.

families.name: Metallic / CDW TMDs
families.description: Layered metallic TMDs with superconductivity, charge-density waves, valley physics, and strong electron-phonon coupling.

families.name: Black phosphorus / phosphorene
families.description: Anisotropic puckered 2D semiconductor; ARPES emphasizes direction-dependent dispersion and thickness-tuned gaps.

families.name: 2D magnets
families.description: Van der Waals magnetic crystals; ARPES and spin-sensitive probes connect exchange splitting, magnetism, and dimensionality.

families.name: MXenes
families.description: 2D transition-metal carbides/nitrides with surface terminations; useful for metallic bands, functionalization, and device interfaces.

materials.tc_note: Zero-gap Dirac material; no intrinsic superconducting Tc in this seed entry.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Photon energy and polarization select pi-band intensity; substrate and doping shift the Dirac point.
materials.source_note: Representative 2D Dirac material; verify exact sample substrate, twist, and carrier density before publication.

materials.tc_note: Representative low-temperature correlated/superconducting moire platform; exact Tc depends on twist angle and filling.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Micro/nano-ARPES is often needed because domains and twist-angle uniformity matter.
materials.source_note: Use as a seed entry for moire 2D materials; verify exact device structure and measurement method.

materials.photon_arpes_notes: Often used as a clean substrate or encapsulation layer for ARPES on 2D heterostructures.
materials.source_note: Representative h-BN band gap; verify thickness and dielectric environment for quantitative use.

materials.tc_note: Semiconducting 2D TMD; superconductivity can emerge under doping/gating in related conditions.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Valley and orbital selectivity depend on polarization and sample orientation.
materials.source_note: Representative monolayer optical gap scale; ARPES quasiparticle gaps depend on substrate and screening.

materials.photon_arpes_notes: Spin-orbit split bands are sensitive to polarization and energy resolution.
materials.source_note: Representative 2D TMD entry; verify exact layer number and substrate.

materials.tc_note: Phase-dependent electronic structure; superconducting/semimetallic behavior appears in specific phases or tuning.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Phase purity and temperature history are critical for ARPES interpretation.
materials.source_note: Representative polymorphic TMD; verify 2H/1T'/Td phase before using values.

materials.tc_note: Few-layer Tc depends on thickness, disorder, and substrate.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Low-temperature high-resolution ARPES is useful for resolving CDW gaps and superconducting gaps.
materials.source_note: Representative layered superconductor; verify exact layer count and Tc.

materials.tc_note: CDW seed material; superconductivity can appear under doping or pressure in related studies.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Photon-energy dependence helps separate kz dispersion and surface sensitivity.
materials.source_note: Representative 2D CDW material; verify sample stoichiometry and dimensionality.

materials.tc_note: Semiconducting 2D material; pressure/doping can strongly tune transport.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Air sensitivity and surface preparation dominate ARPES data quality.
materials.source_note: Band gap depends strongly on thickness and environment; verify exact flake thickness.

materials.tc_note: Magnetic transition is the key parameter rather than superconducting Tc.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Air sensitivity and magnetic-domain control are important for clean spectra.
materials.source_note: Representative 2D magnet seed; verify magnetic transition temperature and layer count.

materials.tc_note: Metallic MXene seed entry; functionalization controls surface states.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Surface chemistry and termination mix must be documented for ARPES comparison.
materials.source_note: Representative MXene entry; exact Tx termination distribution should be measured.

materials.tc_note: Apparent pairing scale and Tc proxy depend on measurement method and interface conditions.
materials.photon_arpes_notes: Often measured by in-situ MBE + ARPES; substrate phonons and annealing are central variables.
materials.source_note: Representative 2D superconducting interface; verify exact Tc criterion and sample preparation.
